blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday swore in Finance Undersecretary Ma. Angela Ignacio as the new president and chief executive officer of the Maharlika Investment Corp. (MIC), which manages the country’s sovereign wealth fund. Ignacio succeeds Rafael Consing Jr., whose three-year term ended on Monday, marking a leadership transition for the state investment firm as it expands its portfolio and reports higher earnings.
